caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #61: CONCILIATORY

conciliatory (adjective): meant to calm anger and restore goodwill.

✅ In a sentence: After the argument, she sent a conciliatory message offering to meet halfway.
✅ Similar: placating, appeasing, peacemaking
✅ Remember it: Verb: conciliate. Related: reconcile.
